iss.description: The issuing instance, an https origin with no trailing slash.

sub.description: base64url(HMAC-SHA-256(instance pepper, identity)): the customer, pseudonymously.

itm.description: The item's id on the issuing instance.

typ.description: A booking or an order; a refund (a return or a withdrawal of one) since rules version 6.

iat.description: Issued at, Unix seconds: the causing event's time.

out.description: The outcome, exactly when knd is outcome.

ref.description: With an outcome or an amendment: the nonce of the item's earliest promise.

due.description: A booking's start; an order's payload.delivery.when, else iat + 30 days; the date a refund must be paid by. An amendment names the new one; outcomes copy the latest amendment's, else their promise's.

trm.description: Rules version 6: base64url(HMAC-SHA-256(k, terms_sha)), the terms both sides agreed (their offer's terms_sha) under a key k the business derives for that offer and discloses only to settle a dispute, so nobody can test guessed terms against it. On a promise or an amendment; never scored.

acc.description: Rules version 6, with an amendment: who accepted the change.

aut.description: 1 when the system fired the transition, not a person.

per.description: One entry per network holding a presentation for the item; each network reads only its own.

n.description: A network's lowercase punycode host: its API is https://<host>.
